hcontainer.name: clause
hcontainer.heading: Things done by, or in relation to, COAG

content.p: Anything done by, or in relation to, COAG under, or for the purposes of, a particular amended Act before the commencement time has effect after that time as if the thing had been done by, or in relation to:
(a) if the amended Act is the Infrastructure Australia Act 2008—the body described in subsection 6(2) of that Act (as amended by Part 2 of this Schedule); or
otherwise—the First Ministers’ Council under, or for the purposes of, that particular amended Act.

hcontainer.name: clause
hcontainer.heading: Things started but not finished by COAG

content.p: before the commencement time, COAG started doing a thing under, or for the purposes of, a particular amended Act; and
immediately before that time, COAG had not finished doing that thing.
(a) if the amended Act is the Infrastructure Australia Act 2008—the body described in subsection 6(2) of that Act (as amended by Part 2 of this Schedule); or
otherwise—the First Ministers’ Council under, or for the purposes of, that particular amended Act;
may finish doing the thing under, or for the purposes of, that particular amended Act.

hcontainer.name: clause
hcontainer.heading: Things done by, or in relation to, a former Ministerial Council

content.p: Anything done by, or in relation to, a former Ministerial Council under, or for the purposes of, a particular amended Act before the commencement time has effect after that time as if the thing had been done by, or in relation to, a new Ministerial Council under, or for the purposes of, that particular amended Act.

hcontainer.name: clause
hcontainer.heading: Things started but not finished by a former Ministerial Council

content.p: before the commencement time, a former Ministerial Council started doing a thing under, or for the purposes of, a particular amended Act; and
immediately before that time, the former Ministerial Council had not finished doing that thing.
A new Ministerial Council may, after the commencement time, finish doing the thing under, or for the purposes of, that particular amended Act.

hcontainer.name: clause
hcontainer.heading: Things done by, or in relation to, the Ministerial Conference

content.p: Anything done by, or in relation to, the Ministerial Conference under, or for the purposes of, the ANPHA Act before the commencement time has effect after that time as if the thing had been done by, or in relation to, the Ministerial Council (within the meaning of that Act, as amended by Part 1 of this Schedule) under, or for the purposes of, that Act.

hcontainer.name: clause
hcontainer.heading: Things started but not finished by the Ministerial Conference

content.p: before the commencement time, the Ministerial Conference started doing a thing under, or for the purposes of, the ANPHA Act; and
immediately before that time, the Ministerial Conference had not finished doing that thing.
The Ministerial Council (within the meaning of the ANPHA Act, as amended by Part 1 of this Schedule) may, after the commencement time, finish doing the thing under, or for the purposes of, that Act.

hcontainer.name: clause
hcontainer.heading: Things done by, or in relation to, the Standing Council on Health

content.p: Anything done by, or in relation to, the Standing Council on Health under, or for the purposes of, the NHR Act before the commencement time has effect after that time as if the thing had been done by, or in relation to, the Ministerial Council (within the meaning of that Act, as amended by Part 1 of this Schedule) under, or for the purposes of, that Act.

hcontainer.name: clause
hcontainer.heading: Things started but not finished by the Standing Council on Health

content.p: before the commencement time, the Standing Council on Health started doing a thing under, or for the purposes of, the NHR Act; and
immediately before that time, the Standing Council on Health had not finished doing that thing.

The Ministerial Council (within the meaning of the NHR Act, as amended by Part 1 of this Schedule) may, after the commencement time, finish doing the thing under, or for the purposes of, that Act (as amended by that Part).

hcontainer.name: clause
hcontainer.heading: Things done by, or in relation to, the Council

content.p: Anything done by, or in relation to, the Council under, or for the purposes of, the BC Act before the commencement time has effect after that time as if the thing had been done by, or in relation to, the Council (within the meaning of that Act, as amended by Part 1 of this Schedule) under, or for the purposes of, that Act.

hcontainer.name: clause
hcontainer.heading: Things started but not finished by the Council

content.p: before the commencement time, the Council started doing a thing under, or for the purposes of, the BC Act; and
immediately before that time, the Council had not finished doing that thing.
The Council (within the meaning of the BC Act, as amended by Part 1 of this Schedule) may, after the commencement time, finish doing the thing under, or for the purposes of, that Act.

hcontainer.name: clause
hcontainer.heading: Things done by, or in relation to, the Australian Transport Council

content.p: Anything done by, or in relation to, the Australian Transport Council under, or for the purposes of, the NTC Act before the commencement time has effect after that time as if the thing had been done by, or in relation to, the Ministerial Council (within the meaning of that Act, as amended by Part 1 of this Schedule) under, or for the purposes of, that Act.

hcontainer.name: clause
hcontainer.heading: Things started but not finished by the Australian Transport Council

content.p: before the commencement time, the Australian Transport Council started doing a thing under, or for the purposes of, the NTC Act; and
immediately before that time, the Australian Transport Council had not finished doing that thing.
The Ministerial Council (within the meaning of the NTC Act, as amended by Part 1 of this Schedule) may, after the commencement time, finish doing the thing under, or for the purposes of, that Act.

The Minister may, by legislative instrument, make rules prescribing matters of a transitional nature (including prescribing any saving or application provisions) relating to the amendments or repeals made by this Act.
To avoid doubt, the rules may not do the following:
create an offence or civil penalty;
set an amount to be appropriated from the Consolidated Revenue Fund under an appropriation in this Act;
directly amend the text of this Act.
This Schedule (other than subitem (2)) does not limit the rules that may be made for the purposes of subitem (1).
